title: Sita Ramachandraswamy Temple, Bhadrachalam

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged elevation at the named hilltop shrine point.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named precinct and shrine; Overture Maps roof records
mapIdentity.scope: The named OSM temple precinct and named interior shrine fix the site. Seven Google Open Buildings numerical roof returns through Overture give position and orientation for structures, but exact building assignments, gopuram center, subdivisions and supporting walls are interpreted from the photographic geometry and written site layout.

note: The 20 February 2024 original CC0 images show cream carved tiered towers above white and orange platform walls, relief bands, covered galleries, and roofed stairs. The census describes the hilltop temple, tall entry gopura and sanctuary vimana. Telangana’s dated notice documents the later extension and redevelopment.
